description: This file defines a collection of utility functions for handling data in Uint8Array objects, abstracted to work across Node.js and Web environments. It exports the ByteUtils type and a singleton ByteUtils object that provides methods for manipulating binary data such as encoding, decoding, conversion, and memory allocation.

methods.name: toLocalBufferType
methods.description: Transforms input buffer to Uint8Array, depending on environment.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Creates an empty Uint8Array of specified size.

methods.name: allocateUnsafe
methods.description: Creates an empty Uint8Array of specified size, possibly using pooled memory.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks deep equality between two Uint8Arrays.

methods.name: fromNumberArray
methods.description: Creates a Uint8Array from a number array.

methods.name: fromBase64
methods.description: Creates a Uint8Array from a base64 string.

methods.name: toBase64
methods.description: Converts a Uint8Array to a base64 string.

methods.name: fromISO88591
methods.description: Creates a Uint8Array from a legacy ISO8859-1 encoded string.

methods.name: toISO88591
methods.description: Converts a Uint8Array to a legacy ISO8859-1 encoded string.

methods.name: fromHex
methods.description: Creates a Uint8Array from a hex string.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Creates a lowercase hex string from bytes.

methods.name: toUTF8
methods.description: Decodes a segment of Uint8Array into a UTF-8 string, with error handling.

methods.name: utf8ByteLength
methods.description: Returns the byte length of the UTF-8 encoding of a string.

methods.name: encodeUTF8Into
methods.description: Encodes a string into a destination Uint8Array at a specified byte offset.

methods.name: randomBytes
methods.description: Generates a Uint8Array of random bytes of specified length.

methods.name: swap32
methods.description: Swaps byte order in-place for 32-bit words in a Uint8Array.

ctags.name: Buffer
ctags.pattern: /^declare const Buffer: { new (): unknown; prototype?: { _isBuffer?: boolean } } | undefined;$/

ctags.name: ByteUtils
ctags.pattern: /^export const ByteUtils: ByteUtils = hasGlobalBuffer ? nodeJsByteUtils : webByteUtils;$/

ctags.name: nodeJsByteUtils
ctags.pattern: /^export const ByteUtils: ByteUtils = hasGlobalBuffer ? nodeJsByteUtils : webByteUtils;$/

ctags.name: prototype
ctags.pattern: /^declare const Buffer: { new (): unknown; prototype?: { _isBuffer?: boolean } } | undefined;$/
